decisive_items: dilated ducts with broad papillary structures
densely packed tumor cells with moderately atypical nuclei
response.rationale: The presence of dilated ducts, atypical nuclei, and specific immunohistochemistry results support Invasive Ductal Carcinoma, while the broad papillary structures and mono- to multilayer epithelial covering also support Intraductal Papillary Carcinoma, but the absence of myoepithelial markers and lack of a fibrous cystic capsule contradict the latter diagnosis.

rejected.why: The imaging findings are not specific enough to support Cystic Hypersecretory Carcinoma as the most likely diagnosis.
The presence of atypical nuclei and fused papillary networks contradict Ductal Carcinoma In Situ.
